title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks
summary: The directive calls for a statewide response plan and greater coordination among government agencies and technology companies as AI-related cyber risks grow.

title: $11M in AI grants aim to help states modernize public benefits
summary: The Center for Civic Futures is funding 11 projects focused on reducing workloads, improving data sharing to help states prepare for changes to SNAP and Medicaid under H.R. 1

title: OpenAI urges Newsom to strengthen California’s AI safety law with additional safeguards
summary: In a letter, the company proposed amendments to SB 53 covering AI model testing, cybersecurity and incident reporting, following a September executive order from the governor calling for stronger oversight of advanced AI systems.

title: Delaware taps former EPA, 18F technology leader as CTO
summary: Greg Godbout steps into the role just two months after Tina Donbeck was announced for the job.

title: Indiana debuts tailored legal case management system for securities enforcement
summary: A customized case management system was developed by Indiana’s Secretary of State’s office to help the Securities Division coordinate investigations.

title: Arizona to use new election results reporting system in November
summary: The statewide rollout of Enhanced Voting software will give voters a centralized website for tracking unofficial election results, with state officials citing transparency and security as priorities.

title: State laws haven’t stopped federal immigration agencies from accessing state DMV data
summary: A handful of states have passed laws meant to stop federal authorities from accessing data, but a new report calls their effectiveness into question.

title: NYC transit agencies test AI tools to modernize infrastructure, data workflows
summary: A new report shows how 17 companies tested tools for infrastructure inspections, maintenance planning and data management with transit agencies in the tri-state area.

title: Illinois rehires former chief data officer to serve as chief AI officer
summary: Tammy Roust rejoins the state after Kader Sakkaria quietly departed the CAIO role after just a month on the job.

title: State, local website improvements crucial as more residents use AI assistants to get important info, report says
summary: Residents are relying more on AI-powered summaries for information. Governments can do more to make sure they’re accurate, the report says.
